preconditions.description: The number of vertices N and queries Q are at least 1.
The input contains exactly N-1 edges defining a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= N for v in vertices_in_edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints are valid vertex indices between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: len(A) == N and all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in A)
preconditions.description: The array A has N elements, each between 1 and 10^9.
The number of query lines matches Q.

preconditions.expression: all((q[0] == 1 and len(q) == 3 and 1 <= q[1] <= N and 1 <= q[2] <= 10**9) or (q[0] == 2 and len(q) == 2 and 1 <= q[1] <= N) for q in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query is either type 1 (v, x) or type 2 (v) with valid parameters.

postconditions.expression: len(output_lines) == sum(1 for q in queries if q[0] == 2)
postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of type 2 queries.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line) % (10**9 + 7) == int(line) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a non-negative integer modulo 10^9+7.

postconditions.expression: all(computed_sum_mod == int(output_lines[i]) for i, computed_sum_mod in enumerate(computed_sums))
postconditions.description: For each type 2 query, the output matches the sum of vis[u] for all u in the subtree of v (rooted at 1), computed by the modified DFS algorithm where vis[v] increments by 1 for each visit, and the traversal repeats A[v] times for each child branch, modulo 10^9+7.
